help.title: Help
help.intro: Short guides for the most common tasks.
help.signInBody: Use the e-mail address and temporary password given by your administrator. At the first sign-in you choose your own password. Administrators may also need an authenticator app on their phone.
help.usersBody: Open Users, choose Add user, enter the person's name, e-mail and role, and save. Give the temporary password shown on screen to the person privately.
help.orgTitle: Changing the organisation logo and details
help.orgBody: Open Organisation, choose Profile & branding, upload the logo and emblem, and save.
help.lockedBody: After several wrong passwords an account is locked for a few minutes. Wait and try again, or ask your administrator to issue a temporary password.
help.meetingBody: Open Meetings and choose New meeting. A step-by-step guide asks for the details, the sessions and presenters, the presentations and supporting material, who may open the meeting, and the QR code; then you review and publish. Everything is saved as you go.
help.uploadBody: Open the meeting, go to Sessions & material, choose Add presentation in the session, and upload the file. For PowerPoint and Word files, also upload a PDF copy (File → Save as → PDF) so participants can read it on their phones.
help.presenterBody: Open Presenters and choose Add presenter. Presenters do not need a login; add one only if they should upload their own material.
help.versionsBody: Upload a new version. Earlier versions are kept in the version history and an administrator can make an earlier version current again.
help.qrTitle: How to show the QR code at the meeting
help.qrBody: Publish the meeting, open it and go to QR code & access. Choose Show full screen for a projector or TV, Print for a notice board or table card, or Download image to put it on your opening slide. If the QR code reaches the wrong people, choose Replace with a new QR code — the old one stops working at once.
help.accessTitle: Choosing who can open the meeting, and when
help.accessBody: In QR code & access, choose whether participants must enter their details, and when the QR code works (around the meeting time, between chosen dates, or at any time). For closed meetings, set a passcode and announce it in the hall.
help.participantsBody: Open the meeting and go to Participants. You see everyone who registered, when, and how many documents they opened. Details are removed automatically after the retention period chosen in Organisation → Participants.
help.phoneTitle: What participants see on their phones
help.phoneBody: Participants scan the QR code with the phone camera — no app or account is needed. They enter their details once, then see the sessions and can open each presentation. Documents fit the screen; Full screen shows one page at a time (swipe or tap the sides to turn pages). Download appears only where you allowed it. Viewing in a browser cannot prevent screenshots.
help.presentBody: On the meeting page choose Start presentation. A clean screen shows the session now on, the next one, a countdown and the meeting timer, with the QR code at the side. Use ← and → (or the buttons at the bottom) when the meeting runs early or late; T returns to the timetable, Q shows or hides the QR code, C the participant count, F full screen. Run PowerPoint separately as usual.

attendance.title: Participants
attendance.name: Name
attendance.privacyNote: Participant details are personal data. They are visible only to administrators and organisers of your organisation, and are removed automatically once the retention period set in Organisation → Participants has passed after the meeting. Attendance counts are kept.

wizard.title: New meeting
wizard.intro: Set up the meeting step by step. Everything is saved as you go — you can stop and continue later from the meeting page.
wizard.help_details: Title, date, time and venue. A reference number is given automatically if you leave it empty.
wizard.help_sessions: Add one session for each presenter or topic, with its time slot. Choose the presenter from the directory or add a new one.
wizard.help_presentations: Upload each session's presentation. For PowerPoint and Word files, also upload a PDF copy so participants can read it on their phones.
wizard.help_attachments: Add any supporting documents for each session (circulars, notes, annexures). This step is optional.
wizard.help_access: Choose whether participants enter their details, when the QR code works, an optional passcode, and whether files may be downloaded.
wizard.help_qr: Create the QR code now if you want to print it in advance. It starts working when the meeting is published; otherwise it is created when you publish.
wizard.help_review: Check the summary. Problems that must be fixed are marked; warnings can be fixed later.
wizard.addSessionsFirst: Add at least one session first:
wizard.qrReady: Created — ready to print or display
wizard.checkNoSessions: Add at least one session — a meeting cannot be published without sessions.
wizard.checkNoPresentation: "{{session}}" has no presentation yet (you can add it later).
wizard.checkNoPdfCopy: "{{title}}" has no PDF copy — participants cannot read it on their phones until one is uploaded.
wizard.publishedBody: Participants can now scan this QR code to open the presentations and supporting material (from the opening time you chose).
